classification: Authored, guided preset demonstration. No unguided comparison arm, effectiveness experiment or measured improvement.
usage: Treatment-only proposed design guidance for future isolated matched runs; both arms should receive the same functional requirements/data and quality goal. Freeze prompts, fixtures, guides, permitted repairs and evaluation before running. Preserve all actual first outputs; do not select favorable examples.
